annotation.authors_or_issuer: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (ACHPR)
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls on States to ensure AI and robotics are compatible with the African Charter and uphold dignity, equality, transparency and accountability
Urges adaptation of imported technologies to African context and inclusion of African values such as Ubuntu
Calls on the AU to develop a regional regulatory framework for AI and robotics
Appeals for meaningful human control to be codified as a human rights principle
Commits the Commission to a study with an African Group of Experts on AI and new technologies
annotation.summary_en: Resolution of the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (Feb 2021) calling for a study on AI, robotics and emerging technologies and human rights in Africa. It urges rights-compatible development, transparency, African values, a regional regulatory framework, and meaningful human control codified as a human rights principle.
